title: Yield typed guidance and resume without treating advice as approval
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`, loads the `verify_repair` durable graph (controller `story`, store `memory`). When a run needs higher-level judgment, start returns an advice yield with a typed question and choices. The driver answers in a later call; the run completes. This is not a human approval interrupt (`fangore_insp_approval_interrupt`) and not an in-process sparse advisor consult (`fangore_insp_sparse_advisor`). He walks product steps (start, answer) and verifies completion from the structured observation expects on this scenario. [^insp-ioc-02]
implementation: `GuidanceRequest` / `GuidanceResponse` / `GraphYield` with kind `advice_requested`; `DurableGraphGenerator.resume` validates request_id, choice schema, and rejects `requested_authority=final_approval` so ordinary advice cannot unlock approval-only mutations.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `session.yaml`: environment + graph + steps + complete expects.
